index.title: Settings
index.name: Name
index.sessionsDesc: Browsers where you are signed in to the web UI. You can find connected coding tools under {link}.
index.notifyLabel: Email when the status of my upstreams changes
index.notifyDesc: We email you when an upstream becomes unreachable or rejects authentication, and once more when it works again. At most one email per upstream and state per time window (default: one hour).
index.emailHint: You use this to sign in.
index.deleteAccountDesc: Removes all your upstreams, secrets, tokens and client access. This cannot be undone.
index.notifyNewClientDesc: When a client signs in for the first time, especially an unknown one.
index.notifyWeeklyDesc: Calls, error rate and slowest upstreams of the last seven days.
index.themeSaveFailed: Could not save the color scheme.
index.deleteDialogBody: All your upstreams, secrets, tokens, client access and statistics are deleted immediately and permanently. This cannot be undone.
index.deleteConfirmEmail: Enter your email address to confirm
index.deleteEmailMismatch: The email address does not match.
index.deleteLastAdmin: You are the last active admin. Promote another admin first.
index.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted.

connections.title: Clients
connections.description: Programs you have authorized via OAuth.
connections.sectionDesc: Revoking ends the session on the next call.
connections.modeSavedMeta: Tool mode: meta tools. Clients now only see find_tools, describe_tool and invoke_tool.
connections.modeSavedDirect: Tool mode: direct. Clients see all active tools again.
connections.modeFailed: Could not change the tool mode.
connections.mode_directDesc: Every active tool is available in the client.
connections.mode_directNote: Default. Fine up to about 50 tools.
connections.mode_metaDesc: The client only sees find_tools, describe_tool and invoke_tool and searches when needed.
connections.mode_metaNote: Saves context for large catalogs. Costs one search step.
connections.emptyIntro: Here is how to connect your first client, for example Claude Code:
connections.step1: 1. Run the command in a terminal
connections.otherClients: Other clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, …) enter this address as an MCP server of type “HTTP”:
connections.step2Text: In Claude Code, enter {cmd}, choose mcpwarden and confirm “Authenticate”. Your browser will open.
connections.step3Text: Sign in here and confirm the authorization. The client will then appear in this list.
connections.noOauth: Your client does not support OAuth? Create a token under {link} and send it as an {header} header.
connections.confirmBody: “{name}” will lose access. This takes effect the next time the client makes a call.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: For clients without OAuth. A token only applies to you.
tokens.limitReached: You have reached the limit of {max} active tokens. Revoke one to create a new one.
tokens.emptyText: Create a token to connect clients without OAuth.
tokens.pickUpstream: Choose at least one upstream or allow all.
tokens.dialogDesc: You set the name, validity and access now. This cannot be changed later.
tokens.fieldDeviceHint: Helps you recognise the token later, for example “NAS”.
tokens.confirmBody: Clients using the token “{name}” lose access immediately.
